initialExam.title: CUET UG 2026 (Common University Entrance Test)
initialExam.description: CUET is the mandatory entrance test for admission to all Central Universities and many state/private universities for UG programs.
initialExam.eligibility: Class 12 pass or appearing in current year
initialExam.syllabus: Section IA: 13 languages. Section IB: 20 languages. Section II: 27 domain subjects. Section III: General Test.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: Up to 3 sections. MCQs with negative marking. 45 min per section.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CUET Score → University-wise Counselling → Seat Allotment → Admission
initialExam.jobRole: Admission to Central/State universities for BA, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA programs
initialExam.careerGrowth: University Degree → Higher Studies / Government Jobs / Career.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit cuet.nta.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
